test_CsvReader_basic_read: test the CsvReader class to read CSV files and extract text and id fields from each row
test_CsvReader_custom_keys: test the CsvReader class with custom text_key and id_key parameters to map CSV columns
test_CsvReader_extra_metadata: test the CsvReader class to store extra CSV columns as metadata on each document
test_CsvReader_limit_skip: test the CsvReader class with skip and limit parameters to paginate over CSV rows
test_CsvReader_adapter: test the CsvReader class with a custom adapter function to transform CSV data before reading
